name: SaaS Dashboard
description: A self-contained Vanilla HTML/CSS/JS SaaS admin dashboard template with KPI cards, an interactive revenue chart, an activity feed, a customer table, dark mode, and a responsive sidebar layout. No frameworks or build step required.
features: Interactive SVG line chart with period toggle (7d/30d/12m) and hover tooltip
Animated count-up KPI cards (revenue, customers, conversion, session)
Light and dark mode with system preference detection and persisted toggle
Responsive sidebar that converts to an off-canvas drawer below 860px
Customer table with row view/delete actions and toast feedback
CSS design-token system (--ds-*) for easy re-theming
Accessible: skip link, semantic landmarks, ARIA on interactive controls, focus-visible rings, reduced-motion safe
Zero dependencies — copy the folder and open preview.html
accessibility: ARIA roles and labels on interactive controls
